clue.text: Cross, having endless pain in face

indicators.note: in places the shortened pain inside the face

parts.note: the face of a clock or watch is its dial

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: agony is severe pain

explanation.surface: Someone cross, with a pained expression on their face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like an adjective for anger, but here it means slanting, and 'endless' only shortens the pain word.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagonal line crosses a shape from corner to corner, so it can be described as cross, slanting.

clue.text: Love is cutting single benefit

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single

indicators.note: is cutting into the benefit word means it goes inside it

parts.note: the dole is British state unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: A cut to a single person's benefit, presented as an act of love.
explanation.walkthrough: The dole is the everyday British name for state unemployment benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: To idolise someone is to adore or love them excessively, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Good people in freedom from sin

parts.note: a race is a people or nation

explanation.surface: Good people living free of sin.
explanation.definitionFit: In Christian theology a state of grace is the condition of being free from sin.

clue.text: Women moving forward in emergent body

indicators.note: moving means the letters of women are shifted into a new order

parts.note: on means forward, as in moving on

explanation.surface: Women advancing within a newly formed organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'emergent body' reads like a new organisation, but it is a heavenly body just coming into view.
explanation.definitionFit: The moon at this phase is the heavenly body just emerging from darkness into visibility.

clue.text: Large ears reshaped — such treatment as benefits looker

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

indicators.note: reshaped means the letters of ears are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cosmetic surgery to reshape big ears, improving someone's looks.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'looker' here is an eye, the organ that looks, not an attractive person.
explanation.definitionFit: Laser surgery is a common treatment that corrects eyesight, benefiting the organ that looks.

clue.text: Preserve odd parts in Andean country

parts.note: to can food is to preserve it in tins

indicators.note: odd parts means the first, third and fifth letters of Andean are taken

explanation.surface: Bottling strange bits of food from an Andean nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd parts in' takes A, D, A from ANDEAN. 'Andean country' suggests Peru or Bolivia, but only 'country' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Canada is a large North American nation, so it is a straightforward example of a country.

clue.text: Saint caught by scripture with political bias

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
RI, religious instruction, was the British school subject of scripture
spin is the slanted presentation of politics

explanation.surface: A holy figure caught out by a politically slanted reading of the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: RI stands for religious instruction, a British school subject also called scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Crispin is the patron saint of shoemakers, remembered for Shakespeare's St Crispin's Day speech.

clue.text: Lingerie shortened, not wanting zip that's slack

indicators.note: shortened means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a negligee is a light dressing gown, a piece of lingerie

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the zero is removed from the word not

parts.note: zip means nothing, the letter O

explanation.surface: Lingerie with no zip, taken up short, hanging loosely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortened' cuts NEGLIGEE to NEGLIGE; 'wanting' removes O (zip, nothing) from NOT to leave NT.
explanation.definitionFit: Being slack about one's duties means being careless and lax, the same as being negligent.

clue.text: Satellite appearing in play's miniature scene

indicators.note: appearing in means the satellite is placed inside the play

parts.note: a drama is a play; the 's reads as is
Io is one of Jupiter's moons, a satellite

explanation.surface: A moon is shown in a model scene for a stage play.
explanation.walkthrough: Io is one of the moons of Jupiter, a favourite crossword satellite.
explanation.definitionFit: A diorama is a three-dimensional model display, so it is a scene in miniature.

clue.text: Travellers' god maintaining order

definitions.note: the definition is the travelling people; the apostrophe s reads as has

indicators.note: maintaining means holding, so the god keeps the order inside

parts.note: Ra was the Egyptian sun god
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: The deity of travelling folk keeps everything orderly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Travellers' god' looks like one phrase asking for Hermes or Mercury, but the definition stops at 'Travellers''; the god is the Egyptian sun god.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roma are a traditionally nomadic people, often called Travellers in Britain and Ireland.

clue.text: General oversaw nothing fishy

parts.note: split as over saw: the word saw written backwards, over in the sense of turned

indicators.note: fishy means suspicious or odd, so the letters of nothing are scrambled

explanation.surface: A military commander supervised nothing suspicious.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'oversaw' must be split: 'saw' turned 'over' gives the past tense of be.
explanation.definitionFit: George Washington was commander-in-chief of the Continental Army, a famous American general.

clue.text: Roman lawyer, ogre, returned to secure reserve

indicators.note: to secure means to hold the reserve inside
returned means the monster's name is read backwards

parts.note: an orc is an ogre-like monster
ice means reserve, coolness of manner

explanation.surface: An ancient advocate and a monster come back to lock up a cold store.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reserve' here is coolness of manner, hence ice, not a stockpile.
explanation.definitionFit: Cicero was a celebrated orator and advocate in the courts of the Roman Republic.

clue.text: Prince is detained in serious act of vengeance

indicators.note: detained in means held inside the word for serious

parts.note: real means serious, as in this is for real

explanation.surface: A royal held captive as grave revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprisal is a retaliatory act, harm done in revenge for an earlier injury.

clue.text: Silenced on changing form language takes

indicators.note: changing means the letters of silenced on are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something once silenced alters the shape a language takes.
explanation.definitionFit: Declension is the set of inflected forms nouns and adjectives take in a language such as Latin.

clue.text: Make provision as member's missed appointment

parts.note: a leg is a limb or member; the 's reads as is
being late means missing the appointed time

explanation.surface: Planning ahead because a member of the group failed to turn up.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'member's' as 'member is': LEG + IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Laws provide for things, so to legislate is to make legal provision by passing laws.

clue.text: Some rabbis mocked specific doctrine

indicators.note: some means only part of the words rabbis mocked is used

explanation.surface: Some rabbis ridiculed a particular religious teaching.
explanation.definitionFit: An ism is any distinctive doctrine or ideology, such as socialism or Buddhism.

clue.text: Welshman where congregation sits facing west

indicators.note: facing west in an across answer means read right to left

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church where worshippers sit

explanation.surface: A Welshman's spot in chapel, turned away from the altar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'facing west' reads NAVE from right to left. Churches traditionally face east, so it is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Evan is a typical Welsh forename, the Welsh form of John, so it denotes a Welshman.

clue.text: Suppress key report that's shocking

parts.note: to ban something is to suppress it
G is a musical key

explanation.surface: Hushing up a crucial, scandalous report.
explanation.definitionFit: A bang is a sudden loud noise, a report like a gunshot that startles anyone nearby.

clue.text: Trouble editor to cover sailors decorated

indicators.note: to cover means the trouble and editor pair go round the sailors

parts.note: ado is fuss or trouble
RN is the Royal Navy, the British fleet's sailors

explanation.surface: Bothering the editor to report on sailors who were honoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cover' reads like reporting a story, but it wraps the first two pieces around the Royal Navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something adorned is ornamented or embellished, the same as decorated.

clue.text: God's claim? One backed it in Mahatma Revisited

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: revisited means looked at again in a new form, so all these letters are rearranged
backed means the little word it is read from the end

explanation.surface: A boast of divinity found in a fresh study of Gandhi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' turns IT into TI, and 'Revisited' rearranges I, TI and MAHATMA together.
explanation.definitionFit: In Exodus, God tells Moses from the burning bush that His name is this phrase, a self-declaration.

clue.text: Man roadies thrashed

indicators.note: thrashed means beaten about, so the letters of roadies are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fellow who gave the band's road crew a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: Isadore is a male given name, so it stands in for a man in crosswords.

clue.text: Living space somewhat limited in Derby?

indicators.note: limited in means held inside the hat

parts.note: a derby is an American name for a bowler hat
a bit means somewhat, slightly

explanation.surface: Accommodation that is a little cramped in the English city of Derby.
explanation.walkthrough: Derby looks like the English city, but the question mark flags the American name for a bowler hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A habitat is the natural home or environment where an animal or plant lives.

clue.text: Beer firm evacuated Southport plant

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer
CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

indicators.note: evacuated means emptied, so only the outside letters of Southport stay

explanation.surface: A brewery firm cleared out of its site in Southport, a seaside town in northwest England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evacuated' empties SOUTHPORT to leave ST. Southport is an English seaside town; 'plant' suggests a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: Alecost, or costmary, is an aromatic herb once used to flavour ale, so it is a plant.

clue.text: Interminable nonsense about on street

indicators.note: about means the nonsense word goes round the others

parts.note: cant is hypocritical talk, nonsense

explanation.surface: Endless rubbish talked about life on the street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Interminable' might suggest dropping a final letter, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something constant never stops, so it seems endless or interminable.

clue.text: First person in jazz making three-note chord

indicators.note: in means the pronoun is placed inside the jazz word

parts.note: trad is traditional jazz
I is the first person pronoun

explanation.surface: A lead jazz musician playing a basic chord.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts I inside TRAD, short for traditional jazz.
explanation.definitionFit: In music theory a triad is a chord built from three notes, a root plus third and fifth.

clue.text: Is it smoking jacket that becomes one?

definitions.text: Is it smoking jacket that becomes one?

parts.words: Is it smoking jacket that becomes one?
parts.note: a jacket that is smoking, on fire, is literally ablaze, so it becomes a thing that blazes

explanation.surface: Asking which garment turns into a smoking jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'smoking jacket' is a lounging garment, but here 'smoking' means burning: a jacket on fire is a thing that blazes.
explanation.definitionFit: A blazer is a jacket, and literally it is anything that blazes, as a burning jacket would.

clue.text: City border with kilometres for parking

indicators.note: for means in place of, so one letter replaces another

parts.note: an apron is an edging strip, such as the area bordering a stage or runway
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
K is short for kilometres

explanation.surface: A city boundary where kilometres of land are taken for car parks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' swaps K into APRON in place of P.
explanation.definitionFit: Akron is a city in Ohio, USA, once the centre of the tyre industry.

clue.text: Stagnation irritated rival

indicators.note: irritated means stirred up, so the letters of stagnation are rearranged

explanation.surface: A competitor annoyed at being stuck in a rut.
explanation.definitionFit: An antagonist is an opponent or adversary, someone who competes against you.

clue.text: Iodine in decay gives dazzling display

indicators.note: in means the symbol goes inside the decay word

parts.note: rot means decay
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: Iodine in decomposing matter producing a bright show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts I inside ROT. Think of 'a riot of colour'.
explanation.definitionFit: A riot of colour is a vivid, profuse display, so the word can mean a dazzling show.

clue.text: Stick heard to shatter — ultimately brittle

indicators.note: to shatter means to break up, so the letters of heard are rearranged
ultimately means the final letter of brittle

explanation.surface: A stick was heard snapping, being brittle in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to shatter' rearranges HEARD into ADHER; 'ultimately' adds the E ending 'brittle'.
explanation.definitionFit: To adhere is to cling or stay fixed to something, the verb sense of stick.

clue.text: Greek character observed pulling back trigger

indicators.note: pulling back means the combined letters are read from the end

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet
noted means observed

explanation.surface: A Greek seen drawing back the trigger of a gun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pulling back' reads ETA + NOTED from right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: To detonate a bomb is to set it off, which is what triggering it does.
